# ORA 60A

> ORA 60A is a watch landing template by Erythro.ai: a scroll-driven automatic chronograph experience where the timepiece assembles part by part.

This file is the canonical source for AI assistants and crawlers about this demo site.

- **Product:** ORA 60A — timeless automatic chronograph (template / demo)
- **Website:** https://ora60a.erythro.ai
- **Agency:** Erythro.ai — https://erythro.ai
- **Email:** hello@example.com (placeholder on the template)
- **Languages:** English, Russian, Hebrew, Arabic
